question: Who scored centuries in both innings of the 1st Test against England at Headingley in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishabh Pant**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Virat Kohli**, though a legendary figure in **Indian** cricket and a prolific run-scorer, did not achieve the milestone of scoring centuries in both innings of the **Headingley** Test in **2025**. **Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.** 
• **Rishabh Pant** etched his name in the history books by scoring centuries in both the first and second innings of the **1st Test** against **England** at **Headingley** in **2025**. **Hence, statement 2 is correct.** 
• **KL Rahul** was a key part of the top order during the **2025** series, but he did not record twin centuries in this specific match at **Leeds**. **Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.** 
• **Jasprit Bumrah**, the premier **fast bowler** and a vital leader in the **Indian** attack, focused on his bowling performance and did not score centuries in both innings. **Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.** 
• The feat made **Rishabh Pant** the first **Indian wicket-keeper** to score twin centuries in a Test match played in **England**, significantly boosting **India's** position in the **ICC World Test Championship**. 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Rishabh Pant**.* 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Headingley Cricket Ground:** 
• Located in **Leeds**, **West Yorkshire**, this historic ground was established in **1890** and has been a primary venue for **Test cricket** in **England** since **1899**. 
• The ground is famous for some of the most dramatic matches in cricket history, including the **1981 Ashes Test** and the **2019** heroics by **Ben Stokes**. 
• **Twin Centuries in Test Cricket:** 
• Scoring a century (**100 runs** or more) in both innings of a single **Test match** is a rare achievement that requires immense concentration and physical stamina. 
• Other **Indian** legends who have achieved this include **Vijay Hazare**, **Sunil Gavaskar** (who did it three times), **Rahul Dravid**, **Virat Kohli**, **Ajinkya Rahane**, and **Rohit Sharma**. 
• **Rishabh Pant's Profile:** 
• Born on **October 4, 1997**, in **Roorkee**, **Uttarakhand**, **Pant** is a left-handed **wicket-keeper-batsman** known for his aggressive and fearless approach. 
• He made his Test debut in **2018** and has since become a match-winner for **India** in overseas conditions, including memorable knocks in **Australia** (Gabba, **2021**) and **England** (Edgbaston, **2022**). 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Match Conditions:** The **1st Test** at **Headingley** in **2025** was played in typical **English** conditions during **June**, where the **Duke ball** offered significant swing and seam movement, making **Pant's** achievement even more remarkable. 
• **ICC World Test Championship (WTC):** This match was part of the **WTC 2025-2027** cycle. **India's** victory, fueled by **Pant's** twin tons, secured **12 points** for the team in their quest to reach the **WTC Final** at **Lord's**. 
• **Statistical Milestone:** By scoring twin centuries, **Pant** joined an elite global group of wicket-keepers like **Adam Gilchrist** and **Kumar Sangakkara** who have dominated games with the bat while maintaining their keeping duties. </ul
